description: A simple rustic squirrel mascot inspired by a casual hand-drawn doodle, for a minimalist personal research notebook blog. Full body, sitting upright, facing mostly forward, large curled tail, small ears, slightly uneven simple body shape, tiny black eyes, small understated mouth, a mildly absent-minded thoughtful expression. Holding a small violet notebook. White and light gray body, charcoal black single-color outline, a small violet accent. Crisp pixel art, limited palette, flat shading, readable silhouette, centered with margin. No text, no scenery, transparent background.
